text:
rita: Follow-up from the March 17th postmortem - repeated tail latency pattern across inference fleet. Need owners, clear ETAs, and a change to how we track recurrence in dashboards. Keep replies short, we'll stitch into the action tracker.

jon: TL;DR: p95/p99 spikes tied to batch sizing + cross-zone cache invalidation. Similar fingerprint seen 4x in last 35 days. Immediate ask: reduce error-budget bleed and avoid broad SLO changes.

cecil: I propose two parallel threads: (A) quick operational guardrails that auto-enable on recurrence, (B) medium-term fixes (autoscaler dampening + shard rebalance). I'll own (B).

ops: For (A) we can add a temporary "SLO probation" flag that, when recurrence_index > 2, triggers backpressure and disables large-background batches for 1h blocks. ETA to implement flag + runbook: 2026-04-02.

sre-bot: Runbook suggestion: when recurrence_index increments for same fingerprint > 2 in 30d, create a repeat-incident ticket and assign SEV2. Also auto-add label "recurrence-prone" to incident.

jon: Owners suggestion: - autoscaler dampening + bench: cecil - probation flag + runbook wiring: ops - recurrence detection in dashboard: rita - customer-impact threshold + escalation doc: jon

rita: I'll add a new dashboard tile: "recurrence_index" (counts similar fingerprints / 30d), a 24h p95 breach rate, and a small bar for zone contribution. ETA 2026-03-29. Will link PR.

ops: Draft alert to page only on sustained recurrence (code block):
```
alert: TailLatencyRecurrence
expr: (recurrence_index > 2) and (increase(request_latency_p95[24h]) / max(1, increase(request_count[24h])) > 0.12)
for: 90m
labels:
  severity: page
annotations:
  runbook: https://git.redwood.ai/infra/runbooks/tail-recurrence.md
  summary: "Sustained tail latency recurrence detected"
```
This avoids sprinty blips but pages on repeated bad patterns.

cecil: For autoscaler dampening: plan is week1 bench + stability tests, week2 staging canary, week3 phased prod. ETA complete: 2026-04-20. I'll publish bench scripts to infra.

jon: Customer escalation threshold: if monthly error-budget burn attributable to recurrence > 2.5% after the medium-term fixes, we prepare a joint product+acct note. I'll draft template by 2026-03-31.

rita: Actions (owners + ETA): - recurrence tile & alert wiring: rita/ops, ETA 2026-03-29 - probation flag + runbook: ops, ETA 2026-04-02 - autoscaler dampening bench + rollout: cecil, ETA 2026-04-20 - customer escalation template: jon, ETA 2026-03-31 - postmortem tracker update + weekly status: rita, ongoing

cecil: ack. Starting bench today, will post baseline numbers to GH. PR: https://git.redwood.ai/infra/bench/pulls/11

ops: ack. Created dashboard PR: https://git.redwood.ai/infra/dashboards/pulls/212 and runbook stub: https://git.redwood.ai/infra/runbooks/pulls/8

jon: ack. Draft escalation template link: https://git.redwood.ai/docs/sla/escalation-templates.md (will finish by ETA).

sre-bot: Canary scheduled by cecil for 4005010000. Notifying rotation.

rita: I'll post a one-line status update every Friday here and update the postmortem tracker. If any ETA slips, tag me and we'll escalate.

jon: Final note: prefer prevention over SLO relaxation. Use probation flag + guarded rollouts. If we still see recurrence after full rollout (4+ similar incidents in 30d or >2.5% burn) we will open an SLA review with product.

deploy-bot: Canary deployment queued by cecil at 4005010000. Deployment ID: deploy-2026-04-c11.

rita: thanks all. Short cadence; weekly sync here.
